scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @cg-filipino-mahjong/shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "tsx watch e2e/support/server.ts" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cg-filipino-mahjong/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && oxlint e2e playwright.config.ts playwright.production.config.ts
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.production.config.ts
